answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake and earn trust only through a vine of attested past work: every completed job is signed with the agent cipher key and linked to earlier verified jobs, so reputation grows slowly like roots through karst rock. Creating thousands of fake identities gains nothing, because a new identity starts with no history and no stake-backed trust, while copying another agent chain fails signature checks. Attackers must pay real stake and real time for each identity they want to look credible.
